headline: Ohio Solar Farm Becomes Home to 3 Million Bees
meta_description: An Ohio solar farm is transforming its land into pollinator habitat, hosting over 50 beehives and nearly 3 million honey bees while training veteran beekeepers.
summary_short: A solar farm in Ohio is now home to more than 50 beehives and nearly 3 million honey bees, creating pollinator habitat while supporting beekeeper training.
body:
An Ohio solar farm is now home to more than 50 beehives and nearly 3 million honey bees. The project transforms the land surrounding its solar panels into a thriving pollinator habitat—space that might otherwise remain unused.

Veteran beekeepers are using the site as a training ground for others, turning the initiative into both an environmental and educational effort. By combining renewable energy infrastructure with habitat restoration, the farm demonstrates how industrial land can serve multiple purposes: generating clean power while supporting the bee populations crucial to agriculture and ecosystems.
quick_facts: Over 50 beehives at an Ohio solar farm
Nearly 3 million honey bees living on the site
Veteran beekeepers training others at the location
Solar panels surrounded by pollinator habitat
